hero.title: About XINPUREAO
hero.subtitle: A shower filter manufacturer dedicated to healthy shower water. 15 years, 60+ countries, and a 25,000 m² factory of in-house production.

story.title: Engineering healthy shower water since 2010
paragraphs: XINPUREAO was founded by a team of water-treatment engineers with a simple belief: the quality of shower water matters as much as the quality of drinking water. Today we design, manufacture, and export to more than 500 brand and distributor partners in 60+ countries.
Our 25,000 m² production facility runs 18 injection machines, 3 assembly shifts, and an in-house R&D and QC lab — so we control quality, cost, and lead time under one roof.

items.title: Company founded
items.text: Founded as an inline shower filter manufacturer in Xuzhou, China.

items.title: First ISO 9001 certification
items.text: Production system certified. First bulk export to EU customers.

items.title: Launched vitamin C filter
items.text: Developed SPA-grade vitamin C cartridge formulations.

items.title: Expanded factory 2x
items.text: Doubled injection and assembly capacity. New R&D lab.

items.title: Private label OEM program
items.text: Formal private label program serving Amazon and retail brands.

items.title: 1.2M+ units / year
items.text: Today producing 1.2 million+ units yearly and growing.

items.title: Quality First
items.text: Every batch is tested for flow, pressure, chlorine reduction, and material safety before release.

items.title: Long-term Partnerships
items.text: 85% of our customers repeat year after year. We focus on your long-term growth.

items.title: Sustainability
items.text: Refill cartridge design, recycled carton packaging, and carbon-neutral logistics options.

items.title: Fast Response
items.text: 12-hour response time. English-speaking sales, technical, and project managers.

items.title: Innovation
items.text: 38+ patents and utility models. New product release every quarter.

items.title: Global Reach
items.text: Ship to 60+ countries with localized manuals and packaging.
